author: Totally Not Mark
description:
One Piece is going seasonal, which means we've finally finished Season 1! So we figured we'd upload our 15 hour review of the entire one piece series. From episode 1 during Romance Dawn, through to Arlong Park, Water 7, Thriller Park, Marineford, and all the way to Wano and Egghead! We had so much fun reviewing all of this incredible story with Luffy, Zoro, Nami and the rest of the strawhat pirates. Let us know if you managed to find all of the Pandamen in this video down below in the ocmments!
